mapper.select:
SELECT p.* FROM project p
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_submitter_at FROM task_submission WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY project_id ) recent ON recent.project_id = p.id
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.resource_status = 1 AND p.org_id = #{params.orgId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_workshop pw WHERE pw.project_id = p.id AND pw.user_id = #{params.userId} AND pw.deleted_at IS NULL )
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.keyword}, '%')
AND p.type_id = #{typeId}
AND p.creator_id = #{params.userId}
ORDER BY
p.created_at ASC, p.id ASC
p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
recent.last_submitter_at DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
